point: 用时序逻辑(scTLTL)指定任务,把公式的鲁棒度(robustness degree)自动转成奖励函数,用户只需写逻辑公式
quote_en: In this work, we use the robustness degree of temporal logic formulas as the reward function which is also constructed with nested min/max functions. However, the user only needs to specify the task as a logic formula and the transformation to the reward function is performed automatically.

point: 鲁棒度有严格语义:大于零即表示任务完成
quote_en: The robustness reward also has rigorous semantics such that a value greater than zero indicates completion of the task.

point: 提出用时序逻辑及其等价有限状态自动机(FSA)的三种用法:给RL提供奖励、为CLF做目标选择以引导探索、为CBF定义安全集
quote_en: we propose three ways to use temporal logic and its equivalent finite state automata (FSA) in our system - provide reward for the RL agent, perform goal selection for the control Lyapunov function for guided exploration and define safe sets for the control barrier functions.

point: 扩展FSA增广MDP框架以处理硬约束和规范违反
quote_en: we extend the FSA augmented MDP framework [9] to handle hard constraints and violation of specifications.

point: 把整个系统整合进一个可高效求解的二次规划(QP)
quote_en: we integrate the system into a quadratic program that can be solved efficiently.

point: 在带安全约束、已知系统动力学、未知环境动力学的仿真连续控制任务上演示框架,并研究每个组件的作用与效果
quote_en: we demonstrate the applicability of our framework in a simulated continuous control task with safety constraints, known system dynamics and unknown environmental dynamics, and study the use and effectiveness of each component in the system.

point: FSA增广MDP的奖励鼓励系统离开当前自动机状态、进入下一个,从而最终到达满足规范的终止状态

quote_en: This problem can be solved by adding an additional set of trap states

point: 奖励本身不阻止智能体在学习中违反规范,智能体反而需要探索陷阱状态来学习(故有自环),测试时可选择进入陷阱状态即终止
quote_en: It is important to note that r˜ in Equation (11) does not prevent the RL agent from violating

point: CLF目标选择:挑当前状态下最容易激活的、通向非陷阱状态的出边,取使该边守卫谓词鲁棒度最大的MDP状态作为目标
quote_en: The intuition behind goal selection using the FSA is to find the outgoing edge (leading to a non-trap state) that is easiest for the agent to activate at its current state.

point: 找到目标sg后用一个简单的二次型CLF;案例研究采用该CLF
quote_en: Other CLFs that meet the criteria in Equation (8) can also be used. For simplicity, the above CLF will be adopted in our case studies.

point: CBF约束:把FSA中守卫谓词解释为安全集,通过先转为合取范式(CNF)来阻止智能体进入陷阱状态
quote_en: We exploit the fact that the guarding predicates ψ in an FSA are propositional logic formulas of inequality constraints over states. They can be naturally interpreted as safe sets and incorporated into the CBF.

point: QP中松弛变量δ在CBF与CLF约束冲突时增大;K取很大的正常数(约1e10)
quote_en: K is chosen to be a large positive constant (∼ 1e

point: 把RL动作arl与CLF、CBF动作相加注入已知系统动力学,通过求解TL-CLF-CBF QP(式16)得到安全动作
quote_en: arl is the action provided by the RL agent.

point: 框架同时结合基于模型的规划与无模型学习,可利用已知动力学也能处理未知动力学
quote_en: The system also combines model-based planning and model-free learning so that knowledge about the system dynamics can be taken advantage of while unknown dynamics can also be handled.

point: RL组件用PPO作为学习算法
quote_en: we use proximal policy optimization (PPO) [28] as the learning algorithm.

point: 策略网络为前馈网络,3个隐层分别300/200/100个ReLU单元,值函数同结构
quote_en: The policy is represented by a feed-forward neural network with 3 hidden layers of 300, 200, 100 ReLU units respectively. The value function is of the same architecture.

point: 每个episode时间horizon T=200步,每次更新迭代收集5条轨迹的批,目标区位置episode间随机
quote_en: Each episode has horizon T = 200 steps and the positions of the goal regions are randomized between episodes

point: 每次更新收集5条轨迹的批
quote_en: We collect a batch of 5 trajectories for each update iteration.

point: 智能体MDP状态含位置朝向[x,y,θ]及所有目标与移动障碍位置(13连续维),加1维离散FSA状态共14维
quote_en: Combined with 1 discrete dimension for the FSA state (from construction of the FSA augmented MDP), the total state space is 14 dimensional.

point: 智能体采用独轮车(unicycle)模型,控制量为前进速度av与转向速度aθ;系统欠驱动不可控,用偏移参考点改写为全驱动形式
quote_en: The agent's controls are the forward velocity av and steering speed aθ.

point: 仿真环境:一个已知动力学的智能体、两条直线构成的必须留在内部的通道安全约束、三个圆形目标区(episode内固定、episode间随机)、两个动力学未知的移动障碍
quote_en: two obstacles that move in the vicinity of the channel and whose dynamics are unknown.

point: 四种配置(纯RL、RL+CBF、RL+CLF、RL+CBF+CLF)的折扣回报最终性能相近
quote_en: We can see that all configurations are able to achieve similar end performance.

point: 带CLF的配置在学习初期上升更快(收敛起步更快)
quote_en: The configurations with CLF exhibit faster rising time at the beginning of the learning process.

point: 带CLF的学习曲线方差和波动更大
quote_en: it can also be observed that the learning curves with CLFs show higher variances and volatility.

point: CBF能在整个学习过程中始终阻止智能体违反安全约束
quote_en: We can see that the CBF is able to prevent the agent from violating the safety constraints at all times during learning.

point: 无CBF的配置因为有违反惩罚也会逐渐学到减少违反
quote_en: For configurations without CBF, because a violation penalty is imposed on the agent (Equation (11)), it also gradually learns to minimize violation.

point: 无CBF的配置能与障碍保持更远距离,因为它允许智能体走出安全区
quote_en: The agent is able to keep a further distance from the obstacles in configurations without CBF as this configuration allows the agent to travel outside the safe zone.

point: 在20次评估试验上,带CBF训练的智能体成功率更高(评估时CBF始终开启)
quote_en: The results show that the agents trained with CBF exhibits higher success rates.

point: 评估在20次试验上统计成功率
quote_en: Figure 8 shows the evaluation success rate over 20 trials.

point: CLF+CBF(无RL)配置中,CBF把智能体停在安全区边界导致卡住,且因CLF/CBF都不知障碍动力学而发生碰撞;加入RL后智能体学会改去g1完成任务
quote_en: CLF still commands the agent to g2, however, CBF stops the agent at the border of the safety zone and the agent is stuck.

point: 系统含大量超参(cr、w、K、α、c3及控制界),学习过程与最终性能明显受其影响
